obligations.note: POST /payees/{id}/reopen is bound to the privileged action manage_payees with mfa=False, and LedgerApp requires MFA only when route.mfa is true. The exhaustive control test failed on that route, and EXC-0222 is limited to the reconciliation batch account while the route allows every caller.
reopen_payee updates only status and closed_at. NPI columns are still written through Store._seal, and test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed on the head commit.
reopen_payee calls _audit, which records the actor, action, target, and time. The sampled audit control test passed on the head commit.
The new UPDATE is a fixed SQL string with the payee id bound as a parameter, matching the other Store statements. test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passed on the head commit.
Ticket CHG-26118 is approved by change manager Erik Brandt on 2026-10-21, before review. Its components cover payments.http, payments.routes, payments.service, and payments.store.
Mara Costa, a payments change_approver and a different person from author Sofia Santos, gave a code_review approval of the head commit.
The change is a single commit, 17149d1870c747f70b541fd67c6975c2cce7941e, and both approvals name that commit.
records/ci/run.json reports failure on the head commit. The JUnit report has one failure: tests.controls.test_routes_control#test_privileged_routes_require_mfa, so the full suite did not pass.
The change touches security-sensitive app.py, routes.py, and store.py. Security reviewer Kofi Mensah approved a security_review of the head commit.
The diff is confined to four application files outside controls/, control tests, and ci/, so a control-owner approval is not required.
Ticket CHG-26118 is type standard and the change record is not an emergency, so a post-implementation review is not due.

EXC-0222 is approved by risk owner Helena Vasquez, unexpired at review time, and names MFA-1 on payments.routes, but its scope is the reconciliation batch account. The shipped route drops MFA for every manage_payees caller, so the exception does not cover the deviation.

Acceptance record ACR-0404 covers routes.py with exhaustive MFA-1 evidence, and this change alters that file's behavior. The replacement control test on the head commit failed, so evidence of the same strength is missing.

summary: The reopen route serves privileged action manage_payees without MFA for every caller. EXC-0222 does not cover that deviation because it is limited to the reconciliation batch account, and the prior exhaustive evidence for routes.py has lapsed. CI on the head commit failed the privileged-route control test, so the suite did not pass. Encryption, audit, parameterized SQL, and the other change-ticket and approval records are in order, but those gaps require rejection.
